summary: ISQ Open Infrastructure Co LLC filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of equity securities under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and Regulation S, with aggregate net consideration of $31,920,816 for multiple share classes, and disclosed the monthly transactional net asset value per share as of May 31, 2026. Additionally, the filing notes two asset acquisitions in June 2026: an equity investment in Mercury Data Center Holdings Limited (data centers in Mexico/Central America/Caribbean) and an equity investment in Cube Safety HoldCo Limited (traffic management/road safety in Europe/North America). No material terms, deal value, or restricted shares were stated for the acquisitions. The filing updates operations with no special situation event; it is a routine capital raise and asset purchase update.
